info.title: API.SH: Bandcamp
info.description: The Bandcamp API from API.SH: public Bandcamp data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
An album page: artist, label, release and publish dates, price and currency, name-your-price and free-download flags, tags, genre, credits, about text, UPC, total duration, every track (number, title, duration, link), physical packages (vinyl, CD, cassette, merch: price, stock, edition size) and digital formats. Metadata only: no audio links or lyrics.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bandcamp-album

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The fans who bought an album or track (`type=supporters`) or the reviews they wrote (`type=reviews`): fan id, username, name, profile link, avatar, the review text and favourite track, and the date. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bandcamp-album-supporters

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
An artist or label profile: name, location, bio, image, links, full discography (albums and tracks with release dates and art), upcoming shows, label roster and merch.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bandcamp-artist

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Artist or label link (subdomain.bandcamp.com or a custom domain).

parameters.name: subdomain
parameters.description: Instead of url: the bandcamp.com subdomain.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Instead of url: the numeric band id (from search).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The latest Bandcamp Daily articles (features, album of the day, lists, scene reports...): title, link, section, author, date, summary and image, with the sections present. `category` keeps one section.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bandcamp-daily

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A section slug (e.g. features, album-of-the-day, lists).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Bandcamp Discover: best-selling, new or random releases by genre and tags, format (digital, vinyl, CD, cassette, t-shirts), artist location and time range, with price, release date, track count, duration and featured track. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null at the end.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bandcamp-discover

parameters.name: genre
parameters.description: Genre slug from /bandcamp/v1/discover/options (electronic, rock, metal, hip-hop-rap, jazz ...).

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Tags, several separated by commas (ambient, synthwave ...).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Paging cursor: `next_cursor` from the previous page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A fan's public Bandcamp profile (name, location, bio, website, picture, favourite genre, followers and following counts, collection and wishlist sizes) with their collection or wishlist: release id, type, title, artist, links, cover, date added and their comment. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bandcamp-fan

parameters.name: username

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
